title: Falath PRO Disc Complete Bike
notes: Current authorized Australia Falath Pro Disc complete-bike table lists the Shimano 105 Di2 2x12 option at AUD 6,490 with HB56D 56 mm wheels, Pirelli Road 700x28C tires, OROME Integrated PRO Compact bars and hydraulic discs. It is a regional build and must not supply the retained mainland card wheelset or tire package.
